claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SC-19220 is a weak EP1 prostanoid receptor antagonist that is unlikely to kill cells at 2.5 uM; any observed antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect nonspecific physicochemical/cytotoxic stress rather than EP1 blockade.
